name: log-out
description: A right-pointing arrow leaving a rounded open door in a square frame.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Door centerlines span y7.5..16.5 with radius1.5 corners. Entry door opens left at x12.5 and closes at x16.5; exit is mirrored about12,12 and opens right at x11.5 with left side x7.5. Both arrows point right: entry shaft x7.5..12.5 / head base x9.5, exit shaft x11.5..16.5 / head base x13.5, at y12 with head arms y9..15. Filled uses the exact radius.875 expansion of the C door, outer radius2.375 / inner radius.625, and an analytical merged shaft/solid-head contour; door and arrow stay disjoint. Combined Regular visible bounds6.625..17.375 on both axes; Bold circular clearance exceeds.26px. All None/Square/Circle forms reuse exactly the same native glyph, with no per-frame scale or translation. Outline is Regular1.75 with round caps/joins; Thin1.25 and Bold2.50 use the same centerlines. Standard solid frame exteriors are bounds2..22, Square radius6 / Circle radius10; Outline frame centerlines are bounds2.875..21.125 with radius5.125 / circle radius9.125. Frames remain upright, with2px default outer margins. Framed Filled subtracts the exact standalone Filled silhouette as transparent negative space. All geometry is original to this project; external references establish meaning only. Native X/Y100/100, rotation0. All new forms remain draft pending owner review. Current Square rounding trial: owner requested rounder enclosing frames. The exterior radius is now6 at unchanged bounds2..22; the matching Regular1.75 Outline centerline uses radius5.125 at bounds2.875..21.125. Only the outer enclosing contour changed. Inner glyph coordinates, cutout contours, object-specific rounding and positions remain exact. This rounding trial awaits owner visual review.
